name: Barback
description: A drawer for the Omarchy bar. One chip holds several third-party bar widgets, so a stack of plugins you are trialling takes a single slot instead of one each.
author: Nine Point Labs

barWidget.description: Holds other bar widgets in one collapsible slot. Hover to expand, click to pin open.

schema.label: Show a count on the collapsed chip
Close a pinned drawer with Esc (takes keyboard focus while pinned)
